title: Green Wall at the Desert's Edge
subtitle: 考点：环境变化 / bring about, lack, support
passage: Years ago, Dahe Village lay next to a rough, sandy desert. In spring, sandstorms came often and covered the farmland with dirt. Corn could not grow well because the soil was dry and the villagers lacked water. Many young people left for the city.

Then the government gave the village its support. Experts told the villagers to plant bushes with long roots. The roots hold the soil, and the bushes stop the wind. After ten years, the village was very different. The sandstorms became fewer, and the farmland was green again. Now visitors come to see the bushes, and the village sells corn all over the country. The villagers say, 'Hard work brings about great change.'
vocab: sandstorm 沙尘暴 · farmland 农田 · soil 土壤 · bush 灌木 · root 根 · support 支持
